claim.claim-text: a positioning system coupled to a base, the positioning system including a substantially vertical post (202), the post (202) including a receptacle (210) provided at a top portion of the post (202); and a robotic drive (204) having an attachment interface (220) for engaging the receptacle (210) of the post (202), wherein the receptacle (210) includes a tapered interface (212), and the attachment interface (220) includes a tapered hook (222) configured to engage the tapered interface (212) of the receptacle (210).
2. The robotic medical system of claim 1, wherein the tapered hook (222) and the tapered interface (212) are tapered downward in a vertical plane.
3. The robotic medical system of claim 1, wherein the tapered hook (222) of the attachment interface (220) is formed at a top portion of the attachment interface (220).

4. The robotic medical system of claim 1, wherein the tapered interface (212) formed in the receptacle (210) is tapered downward, the downward tapered interface (212) along with a downward force of the weight of the robotic drive prevents vertical movement of the robotic drive.

5. The robotic medical system of claim 1, wherein the receptacle (210) further comprises a tapered cavity (214) provided orthogonally from the tapered interface (212), and wherein the attachment interface (220) includes a tapered protrusion (224) for insertion into the tapered cavity (214), wherein engagement of the tapered interface (212) and the tapered hook (222) prevent yaw movement of the robotic drive (204), and engagement of the tapered cavity (214) and the tapered protrusion (224) prevent pitch movement of the robotic drive (204).
6. The robotic medical system of claim 5, wherein the tapered protrusion (224) and the tapered cavity (214) are tapered in a horizontal plane.
7. The robotic medical system of claim 5, wherein the receptacle (210) is provided on a top surface of the post (202).

8. The robotic medical system of claim 5, in an engaged position, upon attachment of the robotic drive (204) to the post (202), the tapered hook (222) of the attachment interface (220) is positioned over and around the tapered interface (212) of the post (202).

9. The robotic medical system of claim 5, the tapered cavity (214) of receptacle (210) of the post (202) is formed on a side of the receptacle facing the robotic drive (204) and the tapered protrusion (224) is formed on a side surface of the attachment interface (220) which faces the receptacle (210).

10. The robotic medical system of claim 5, wherein a combination of the engagement of the hook (222) with the protrusion interface (212) and the engagement of the tapered protrusion (224) with the tapered cavity (214) minimizes roll rotation of the robotic drive (204).

11. The robotic medical system of claim 5, wherein a combination of the engagement of the hook (222) with the protrusion interface (212) and the engagement of the tapered protrusion (224) with the tapered cavity (214) provides stiffness of the attachment in six degrees of freedom.
